about: Links between topics, case by case: which pages a text links to (kernel::topics::links_in, and the page spans prose.ts reads, through pageLinkOf in ui/src/pagelinks.ts), each once in the order first written, a link to a reply apart from one to its page. A link is [words](topic:<id>) or [words](topic:<id>#<reply>); nothing in code or a block of code is one, nor a picture's marks, nor a link with no words or an address that is not a page's; but the blocks an article draws as boxes (written ```infobox, ```series or ```note, with nothing after on the line) are read as words. Each case is a text and the links in it, each its page and its reply or null.
cases:
```infobox
title: Frog
Order: [Anura](topic:@-topics-14)
```

```series
title: Amphibians
## Kinds
[Toads](topic:@-topics-15)
```

```note
For frogs in stories, see [Frogs in culture](topic:@-topics-16).
```

```text
[not](topic:@-topics-17)
```
